stat.label: Reported annual revenue for the same solo agency, same window.

statement: Designjoy has been written up at $1M, $1.5M, $1.7M, $2M and $3.1M a year. Every figure traces back to the founder's own posts. Nothing in that chain was ever audited.
source: Starter Story, Startup Stash, startupfounderstories — self-reported, unaudited
